$comment: Collider's values for the x-repo-profile extension points in the pinned ds-skills release's schemas. Pass with --profile to check an artifact against Collider's vocabulary as well as the portable shape. A different repo writes its own file here and changes nothing in schemas/.

destination-name.description: Read by the rail validators, not by a schema: the publish proof's destination.name must equal this literal. Declaring it here is what removes the constant from the validators.

destination-figma-file.description: The one Figma destination Collider publishes to. The proof names it directly; the ledger names it through publish.figmaFile, and the publication binding is what ties the two together.

publish-modes.description: Collider publishes through the repo-owned Figma plugin. The Enterprise Variables REST rail was retired — seat-gated, never run to success, and its code is gone. The Tokens Studio carrier was defined and never used.

tier-policy.description: Mirrors storybook/component-tier-policy.json tierOrder. Keep the two in step.

generated-artifacts.description: Collider's three generated proof surfaces: token docs, recipe docs, runtime CSS parity.
